finding.statement: Forge-to-Distillery idempotence was keyed only by the SHA-256 of the full evaluation envelope. Volatile evaluated_at and candidate-only narration therefore changed the key even when the evidence-bearing execution identity and measured result were unchanged, permitting a semantically identical execution replay to mint another packet and dataset tokens.
finding.existing_witness_limit: The exact-current Forge-to-Distillery witness proves byte-identical replay +0 only; it does not discriminate a timestamp/narration-only replay of the same execution evidence.

hypothesis: A replay-stable execution-evidence identity separated from volatile observation metadata prevents nonsemantic duplicate dataset admission without collapsing genuinely different execution evidence.
counterhypothesis: Full-evaluation SHA-256 is sufficient if all re-observations are guaranteed byte-identical.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_SOURCE_CONTRACT_LEVEL: evaluated_at is intentionally volatile and candidate narration is explicitly non-measured metadata, so byte identity is not a stable causal-event invariant.
fail_closed_behavior: same stable execution identity + same measured evidence + changed timestamp/narration => DUPLICATE
same stable execution identity + changed measured evidence => REPLAY_IDENTITY_CONFLICT and zero new dataset credit
different execution identity => eligible for independent evidence-qualified admission
historical rows migrate additively without rewriting append-only history

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED: strengthens executable Forge-to-Distillery conversion against replay token inflation
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED: adds a reusable typed causal/evidence identity boundary separating stable execution provenance from volatile observation envelope metadata
go_tracks.track_c: ADVANCED_AT_DATASET_SAFETY_SCOPE: prevents nonsemantic replay from inflating future training data while minting zero J-Space/model/training credit

coordination.overlap_search: No open PR matching Forge Distillery evaluation-SHA replay/causal-identity hardening was found before implementation.

next_exact_gate: Execute the focused replay-identity regression plus existing Forge-Distillery ingest/live-bridge regressions on the exact branch head; then fuse only if current main remains nonduplicate. After fusion, strengthen the exact-current runtime witness from byte-identical replay to a timestamp/narration-mutated replay and require zero new packet/token delta.
